svg.title: Mini: Wi-Fi setup has two connections
svg.desc: Phone → ocean’s temporary setup network: Join ASCII-Genesis-Mini-xxxx using the password on the screen. Phone browser → http://192.168.4.1: Enter your home network name and password; tap Save and connect. Ocean → your 2.4 GHz home network: Setup Wi-Fi closes; your phone can return to its usual connection. Check the ocean’s screen: Settings must say Wi-Fi online before checking for updates

g.text: Mini: Wi-Fi setup has two connections
A phone connected to setup Wi-Fi does not mean the ocean is online.
Join ASCII-Genesis-Mini-xxxx using the password on the screen
Enter your home network name and password; tap Save and connect
Setup Wi-Fi closes; your phone can return to its usual connection
Settings must say Wi-Fi online before checking for updates
No internet on the temporary setup network is normal. For a hotspot, see the guide.
